verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state official clients exist for both TypeScript (`npm install supermemory`) and Python (`pip install supermemory`), wrapping the same underlying API, with consistent memory operations (add/search/containerTag) shown in TS examples that map directly to the documented API surface both SDKs wrap. missing for 10: no side-by-side Python code samples (only TS snippets shown) and no independent/hands-on confirmation that the Python SDK's API surface is fully equivalent to TypeScript's.
